tours.name: Archive a Contract
tours.description: Learn how to archive a contract that is no longer needed, for example one created by mistake, without losing the payslips linked to it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to archive a contract that is no longer needed, for example one created by mistake, without losing the payslips linked to it.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Contracts are managed from the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Contracts are managed from the Employees app.

steps.title: Employees menu
steps.description: The Employees menu holds the employee list and the contracts.

description_i18n.en_US: The Employees menu holds the employee list and the contracts.

steps.title: Contracts
steps.description: Every contract of every employee is listed here. Use this list to find the one you want to archive.

description_i18n.en_US: Every contract of every employee is listed here. Use this list to find the one you want to archive.

steps.title: Find the contract
steps.content: Type the name of the contract and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the contract and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

steps.title: Open the group
steps.content: Click the Running group to show its contracts.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Running group to show its contracts.

steps.description: Contracts are grouped by status: New, Running, Expired and Cancelled. Open the group that holds the contract you want to archive.

description_i18n.en_US: Contracts are grouped by status: New, Running, Expired and Cancelled. Open the group that holds the contract you want to archive.

steps.title: Select it
steps.content: Tick the box in front of the contract.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in front of the contract.

steps.description: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to archive them together.

description_i18n.en_US: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to archive them together.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

steps.title: Archive
steps.description: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

description_i18n.en_US: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

steps.description: Archive a contract only if it was never used. A contract that has payslips should be set to Expired or Cancelled instead of being removed.

description_i18n.en_US: Archive a contract only if it was never used. A contract that has payslips should be set to Expired or Cancelled instead of being removed.
